name: EPIC 211008530
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 4, 10.4 solar radii and 1.26 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 1,010 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 4, give 1.26 solar masses and 10.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,704 K at its surface.
